set: B: motion on the live site under a visitor's input, second part: the moment the page takes the arrow, and the moment it gives the arrow back on four sheets at every 1/60 s, consecutive frames

issues.where: the tether between the arrow and the resume tag, 0:30.40 to 0:30.43
issues.what: the cord appears at full length in one frame from nowhere, so the page takes the arrow with no wind-up. There is no reach, catch or snag first, and the grab reads as a pop-in rather than a mechanism
issues.fix: shoot the cord out from the tag over 3 to 4 frames, let it hook the arrow with a 1 to 2 frame jolt on both the arrow and the tag, then pull

issues.what: the arrow snaps through about 120 degrees, from pointing up to pointing down-left, and its tip turns orange, all in one frame. At normal speed it reads as a cut or a swap, not as a body being swung round by a cord
issues.fix: spread the swing over 4 to 6 frames with a little overshoot and settle, and fade in the tip colour over the same span

issues.where: the resume tag and its bracket, lower right, 0:30.47 to 0:30.67
issues.what: while the cord pulls tight and the arrow is dragged onto the tag, the tag hardly moves and the bracket and panel do not answer. Contact is one-sided, and the arrow glides along the loop at an almost even speed, as if moved by hand
issues.fix: have the tag swing and kick back as the cord tensions, ease the arrow in fast with a short stop when it arrives, and add a small shadow or dip on the panel at the moment of contact

issues.where: the slot plate under the panel, 0:43.10 to 0:43.25
issues.what: after the arrow is given back, the metal slot dissolves away over about 8 frames. A machine part fading like a ghost is weightless and goes against the mechanical release before it
issues.fix: close it mechanically: a shutter slides or snaps shut in 2 to 3 frames with a small rebound, or the plate retracts into the panel

issues.what: for one frame the slot shows a dark solid bar, between lighter frames on either side. It reads as a single-frame flicker
issues.fix: make the shutter state change monotonic across frames, with no one-frame dark state

issues.where: the grit spilling from the slot round the arrow, 0:42.53 to 0:42.82
issues.what: the speckle is re-scattered every frame rather than falling and settling, so it shimmers instead of reading as particles with mass
issues.fix: give each grain a persistent position and velocity: fall under gravity, land, then fade

issues.what: the given-back arrow morphs from a tilted system pointer into the upright site arrow while the visitor is already moving it. The change is readable, but it blurs whether control has really been handed back
issues.fix: finish the shape change during the 0:42.70 to 0:43.03 hold, so that the first visitor-driven frame already shows the final arrow
